# Auto-dimming rearview mirror install

## Summary

[Partial] Install an auto-dimming rearview mirror by removing the stock unit and routing 12V switched power to it. [t236]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the stock mirror by pushing its clip toward the windshield and prying it up gently.
2. [Partial] Route a 12V switched power source to the driver's side A-pillar or center console area.

_Procedure reported by [t236]._

## Parts

- Gentex GENK50 auto-dimming mirror kit: Includes mirror, wire shield, temp sensor, and harness with 9' of wire [t236]
- Longer wire cover, optional: To extend the reach to the headliner if stock is too short [t236]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Disconnect the battery before starting wiring work. [t236]
- Use a longer expandable wire shield or aftermarket version for better fitment above the headliner. [t236]
